1 /* 113-icons.js — custom icon set, sheet 1.
2 *
3 * Retires the dock emoji in favour of a commissioned flat-vector icon
4 * family, inlined as 48px WebP data URIs: no extra requests, nothing to
5 * cache-bust separately. Ink recoloured to #9FBCD6 so the glyphs read on
6 * the #20242c dock tiles; amber accents left alone.
7 *
8 * DOCK_GROUPS and DOCK_ITEMS are top-level `const`s in art-core, so they
9 * are not on window: they are reached by indirect eval below. Both are
10 * mutated in place, which is why this file must load after
11 * 104-dock-shape.js, which reshapes them.
12 *
13 * Later sheets should ship as their own file and simply call
14 * NBIcons.add({ key: '<base64>' }, { group: 'key' }, { item: 'key' });
15 * which merges, re-applies and re-renders. No need to touch this file.
16 *
17 * Escape hatch: append ?noicons=1 to the URL to restore the emoji.
18 */
19 (function () {
20 'use strict';
21
22 var ICONS = {
23 compass: "
24 people: "
25 box: "
26 crane: "
27 house: "
28 robot: "
29 save: "
30 bank: "
31 chart: "
32 bag: "
33 factory: "
34 handshake: "
35 };
36
37 /* Rail buttons: one icon each, all seven covered. */
38 var GROUP_ICON = {
39 run: 'compass', people: 'people', market: 'box',
40 empire: 'crane', life: 'house', jarvis: 'robot', system: 'save'
41 };
42
43 /* Sub-tabs. Anything absent keeps its emoji until the next sheet lands
44 (hr, slack, zoom, research, invest, life, milestones, orgchart). */
45 var ITEM_ICON = {
46 bank: 'bank', decisions: 'compass', team: 'people', clients: 'handshake',
47 product: 'box', financials: 'chart', personal: 'house', market: 'bag',
48 assistant: 'robot', saves: 'save', industry: 'factory', empire: 'crane'
49 };
50
51 function uri(key) {
52 return ICONS[key] ? 'data:image/webp;base64,' + ICONS[key] : '';
53 }
54
55 function tag(key, big) {
56 var u = uri(key);
57 if (!u) return '';
58 return '<img class="nb-ico' + (big ? ' nb-ico-lg' : '') +
59 '" data-nb-ico="' + key + '" src="' + u + '" alt="" />';
60 }
